portal.aboutBibliaText: Eight Bible editions in Spanish and English, including Biblia Verbo (our own edition). Hebrew-Greek interlinear with original text, Strong's numbers, and morphology, to work directly with the original languages. Eleven verse-by-verse reference commentaries —Matthew Henry, Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, Keil-Delitzsch, Calvin, and others— plus church history, the Apostolic Fathers, extracanonical literature (1 Enoch, Jubilees, Assumption of Moses) with historical context explained, Bible customs, cross-references, and a weights, measures, and currency converter. All with a unified notes system to organize your study.
portal.aboutBuscadorText: Find passages by idea, not just exact word —in Spanish and English, running right in your browser.
portal.aboutLibreriaText: More than a hundred classic works of the Christian faith for full reading: Chapel Library tracts, the Apostolic Fathers, and classics like The Pilgrim's Progress.
portal.aboutRecursosText: Sermon editor with version comparison and Word export; nearly a hundred articles, reflections, and devotionals; complete Sunday school curricula for children and preteens; sixty historical sermons from Spurgeon, Wesley, Edwards, and others.

lumbrera.heroLead: Lumbrera is Verbo’s free projection software. Prepare song lyrics and passages for a gathering, arrange the service order and control what the congregation sees from your Linux computer.
lumbrera.heroCaption: Lumbrera live: songs, service order, controls and projection preview.
lumbrera.songsTitle: Your song library, ready to project.
lumbrera.songsBody: Keep a local song library. Create new lyrics, edit existing songs and save changes for your next gathering. The preview shows how each screen will look.
lumbrera.songsItem1: Create, edit and save songs in the song library.
lumbrera.songsItem2: Arrange verses, repeat the chorus and remove chords.

lumbrera.bibleImportBody: Import compatible MySword modules (.bbl.mybible and .mybible), e-Sword modules (.bblx and .bbli) and XML using Zefania, OSIS or Holy Bible XML structures. The text becomes available locally for projection.

softwareExtra.desktopSystem: 64-bit Linux (amd64/x86_64). The .deb requires glibc 2.36 or later, for example Linux Mint 22. The .rpm targets openSUSE Tumbleweed. Compatibility with other distributions is not guaranteed.
softwareExtra.desktopVersion: The signed local release is 0.9.0-dev (October 9, 2026). Mint was checked in a compatible build environment, not on a physical Mint computer. Minimum RAM and free disk space have not been established.
softwareExtra.privacyBody: Your library, notes and settings are stored on your computer; Linux application data is in ~/.local/share/verbo-desktop. Local resources can be read offline. Downloading modules, opening links or using remote sources requires internet and contacts their providers.
softwareExtra.privacyReport: The report form on this page opens your email client with the text you write; you decide whether to send it. The page stores your language preference in your browser. Each Bible or module retains its own usage permissions.
softwareExtra.desktopVerifyNote: The RPM has an embedded signature; the DEB uses a separate .asc signature that the graphical installer does not check. Download the key, signature and manifest from the same release. If the name, version or verification does not match, do not install the file.
softwareExtra.desktopMirror: The download buttons retain the existing MEGA links. Their files have not been confirmed to match the local 0.9.0-dev release: the verification files below apply only to the exact filenames shown.
softwareExtra.desktopFingerprint: Compare the full key fingerprint before trusting it. A valid signature authenticates the package origin; it does not guarantee compatibility with your computer.
softwareExtra.lumbreraVerifyNote: The RPM has an embedded signature; the DEB uses a separate .asc signature that the graphical installer does not check. Download the key, signature and manifest from the same release. If the name, version or verification does not match, do not install the file.
softwareExtra.lumbreraFingerprint: Compare the full key fingerprint before trusting it. A valid signature authenticates the package origin; it does not guarantee compatibility with your computer.
softwareExtra.lumbreraRequirements: Linux Mint 22 or later, openSUSE Tumbleweed or Leap 16; Python 3.10+, GTK 4 and libadwaita 1.5+. Use a second display in extended mode to separate controls from projection. Local reading works offline; lyrics search contacts external services.
softwareExtra.lumbreraWorkflow: Save and reopen services as .lumbrera files; add songs, passages, images, video and audio. Control backgrounds, volume, blackout and text from the computer. Shortcuts include F5 for projection, B for blackout and arrow keys to advance. Phone control is not included.
softwareExtra.lumbreraTesting: Tested in Mint 22.2 and Leap 16 containers and with virtual displays. Physical projector connection and disconnection and mouse drag and drop still need a real-world test. Test your setup before a service.
softwareExtra.lumbreraLicense: Free download. The program license is still undecided: LicenseRef-Verbo is a placeholder, not an open-source license. Bibles and songs retain their own terms; RVG 2004 is CC BY-NC-ND and restricts commercial use and derivative works.
